description.narrative: Afya Participações (Afya or the Company) is the leading for-profit player in medical education and market consolidator in the tertiary education segment in Brazil. Headquartered in Minas Gerais, and with a significant exposure to much needed frontier regions in Brazil (60% of total campuses). The proposed IFC investments is a BRL500 million long-term debt facility to help the Company finance acquisitions of medical schools during FY24-25(the Project).

The Development Impact of this Project is driven by improving the access to quality medical education in frontier regions of Brazil, such as the North and Northeast regions, where access to health systems is limited. This Project will address gaps in both the education and health sectors in Brazil, by supporting the Companys geographical expansion into frontier regions through the acquisition of medical schools. This Project expects to provide opportunities to improve the quality of medical education, and supply more medical professionals in the frontier regions, thereby enhancing access to quality healthcare services. In addition, IFC anticipates that the Project has the potential to promote competitive pressures in the medical education sector in Brazil via a demonstration channel.
